Hi Naomi — thanks for the options and the follow-ups. Answers below: 

1) Traffic shape: fairly bursty. We have two peaks: 10:00–12:00 PST and 15:00–17:00 PST. Those windows account for ~60% of daily volume.

4) SLA: p95 under 300ms would be ideal for user experience; p99 we can tolerate up to 1s for the pilot.

Any of the proposed slots work for me except Tue morning. Wed 6/21 14:30 PST is ideal.

Also, I attached a brief traffic extract — should help with batching/throughput planning.

Looking forward to it.
